title: ple Application Domain Model (ADM) Schema v1
description: The mathematical intermediate representation for the ple deterministic intent compiler. This schema defines the rigid boundary between probabilistic semantic translation and deterministic code generation.

domain.description: Top-level domain definition and ubiquitous language glossary.

ubiquitousLanguage.description: Key domain terms and their precise definitions.

boundedContexts.description: Topological sub-graphs defining isolated domain contexts.

aggregates.description: Aggregate roots within this bounded context.

events.description: Immutable domain events in the append-only event store.

payload.description: JSON schema for the event payload.

commands.description: Intent commands that may produce domain events.

projections.description: Read model projections derived from event streams.
